decisions.statement: The page's own file leads the files answered.
A path the page claims that has no body is left out.
A path is kept for holding a body rather than for holding text.
A path with a body that is not text is answered beside the page.
A path claimed twice is answered once.
The world is read rather than the disk.
Nothing here decides whether a page may be acted on.

definition: the files a page claims, read through the world a change reads
